s.d: An expression of surprise (similar to English whoa).

ex: Ich habe viele Jahre vergeudet, ohne dir zu sagen, was du mir bedeutest.
I wasted many years without telling you what you mean to me.
Ich mag Fußball, aber ich kann auch ohne leben.
I like soccer, but I could live without.

s.d: in any case, anyway, either way
ex: Ganz sicher kann man sich ohnehin nie sein.
You can never be entirely sure either way.
Die Behörden reagierten auf die Kundgebungen in mehreren Städten mit weitreichenden Beschränkungen des ohnehin zensierten Internets.
The authorities reacted to the rallies in several cities with far-reaching restrictions on the already censored internet.

s.d: unconscious (Having lost consciousness for a short time as in ohnmächtig werden ("to faint, to pass out").)

ex: Du musst lauter sprechen, meine Ohren sind nicht mehr so gut.
You'll have to speak up, my ears aren't quite as good anymore.

s.d: ear (the external visible part of the organ, the auricle)
ear (the ability and proclivity to understand and discern finer details of something, especially sound-based)
ex: Er hat kein Ohr für Musik.
He has no ear for music.

s.d: the overhanging part on the frame of a window or door
a highway interchange which is ear-shaped or ribbon-shaped
A box on the ear, cuff on the ear
to slap in the face, to box someone's ears
earwig (any insect of the order Dermaptera)
earworm (a tune that pops up in one's memory all of the time)
